reviewItem.question: Does "Copy annotations from Ingress or Gateway to the Certificate: We've added a new configuration option to the cert-manager controller: `--extra-certificate-annota…" mean a change to cli-flag:cert-manager|name=--extra-certificate-annotations|component=controller (added)?
